name: Glyph of Azora
summary: From the Tower of Azora, Theocritus uses Glyphs of Azora to watch distant threats. The inscribed stones extend the Eye of Azora's reach, letting him read enemies' thoughts and plans.

sections.title: Eyes Across the Border
sections.body: Theocritus watches hostile powers from his tower in Elwynn Forest. His crystal relic, the Eye of Azora, lets him see across great distances, but cannot reach into the minds or plans of his adversaries. He places small focuses called Glyphs of Azora on surfaces far away to carry his magic farther. Each glyph anchors his power, letting him read enemy intentions and project his voice across miles to speak with field agents.

sections.title: Espionage in Redridge
sections.body: In the Redridge Mountains, Theocritus places glyphs in hostile territory. He fixes the first to an ancient lion statue overlooking the Tower of Ilgalar, where his rogue rival, the dark wizard Morganth, holds his stronghold. Through the glyph, Theocritus enters Morganth's mind and finds a dispute between the renegade mage and the Blackrock orcs at nearby Stonewatch Keep. To learn the cause, he sends a second glyph into the heights of the keep's intact watchtower, concealed in a discarded liquor jar.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Glyph of Azora?
aliases: what does glyph of azora do
faq.answer: Theocritus uses a Glyph of Azora to extend the Eye of Azora's reach. Set in a distant place, it anchors his magic so he can read his adversaries' thoughts and plans and speak with field agents across miles.

faq.q: Who created the Glyph of Azora?
faq.answer: Theocritus created the Glyph of Azora. He lives in the Tower of Azora along Elwynn Forest's eastern border.

faq.q: Where are the Glyphs of Azora placed?
aliases: where do i put the glyph
faq.answer: One glyph is fixed to an ancient lion statue overlooking the Tower of Ilgalar. A second is hidden in a discarded liquor jar in the intact watchtower at Stonewatch Keep.

faq.q: Why is Theocritus spying on the Tower of Ilgalar?
faq.answer: The Tower of Ilgalar is Morganth's stronghold. The rogue dark wizard is Theocritus's rival, and the glyph lets Theocritus read his thoughts and plans.

faq.q: How does the glyph allow Theocritus to speak to people?
faq.answer: Once fixed to a distant surface, the glyph anchors Theocritus's magic and lets him project his voice across miles to speak with field agents.

angles.text: As a mage, you can use arcane divination to extend crystal scrying into targeted telepathy and remote sensory relays.
As an Alliance member, you can use the glyphs to gather intelligence on Morganth and the Blackrock orcs at Stonewatch Keep.
